In recent times [[Aes Sedai]] divided themselves in many factions. Among these factions was formed a group of sisters that allied themselves directly or indirectly to the [[Dragon Reborn]], under many different circumstances. It can be calculated that the sisters allied to the Dragon were more than eighty, but many of them were [[turned]] to the shadow before the [[Last Battle]].

==Friends==
#[[Moiraine Damodred]], [[Blue Ajah]] {{opsl|19}}-{{opsl|72}}, found the Dragon Reborn and helped him until captured by the [[Aelfinn]], and resumed after her rescue
#[[Siuan Sanche]], [[Blue Ajah]] {{opsl|19}}-{{opsl|41}}, in her own fashion she served the Dragon since his birth, paying a great price, and he then personally acknowledged it
#[[Nynaeve al'Meara]], [[Yellow Ajah]] {{opsl|9}}, she was the only friend Aes Sedai who stayed constantly to his side to help him in many circumstances, one of which was the [[cleansing of saidin|cleansing of ''saidin'']]
#[[Elayne Trakand]], [[Green Ajah]] {{opsl|14}}, helped Rand in the [[Stone of Tear]], but later was occupied in other missions such as the [[Black Ajah]] hunt, finding the [[Bowl of the Winds]] and gaining the throne of [[Andor]]
#[[Egwene al'Vere]] {{opsl|14}}, initially helped Rand (Stone of Tear, [[Aiel Waste]], [[Cairhien]]) but after she was raised to the [[Amyrlin Seat]] she often took a position against Rand's goals, but eventually they came to an agreement

==Dumai's Wells sisters==
Group of 9 [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] (5 Greens, 2 Browns, 1 Gray, 1 Blue) that were forced to swear loyalty to the Dragon after the battle of [[Dumai's Wells]]:
# [[Alanna Mosvani]], [[Green Ajah]] {{opsl|23}}, bonded Rand without permission, enraging him, but later they seemed to reconcile; she released Rand shortly before dying
# [[Bera Harkin]], [[Green Ajah]] {{opsl|20}}, one of the rebels ambassadors to the Dragon in the Waste; followed his orders in Cairhien and Tear; later she probably fought in [[Thakan'dar]] along the other sworn sisters
# [[Faeldrin Harella]], [[Green Ajah]] {{opsl|22}}, part of the rebel embassy to the Dragon in [[Caemlyn]], followed his orders in Cairhien and Tear, she fought in Thakan'dar and was killed by [[Hessalam]]
# [[Kiruna Nachiman]], [[Green Ajah]] {{opsl|20}}, was one of the rebels ambassadors to the Dragon in the Waste, she fought in Thakan'dar and was killed by Hessalam
# [[Masuri Sokawa]], [[Brown Ajah]] {{opsl|22}}, Rebel ambassador to the Dragon in Caemlyn, sent by Rand to help [[Perrin Aybara]] in the South, whose adventures she followed there; during the Last Battle she was in [[Mayene]] where she helped Perrin again
# [[Merana Ambrey]], [[Gray Ajah]] {{opsl|23}}, head ambassador for the Rebel Aes Sedai to the Dragon in Caemlyn, she later successfully lead an embassy to the [[Sea Folk]] and helped to stop the rebellion of the nobility in Tear; later she probably fought in Thakan'dar alongside the other sworn sisters
# [[Rafela Cindal]], [[Blue Ajah]] {{opsl|22}}, Rebel ambassador to the Dragon in Caemlyn, followed his orders in Cairhien and Tear. Later she fought in Thakan'dar alongside the other sworn sisters, [[Wise Ones]] and Sea Folk
# [[Seonid Traighan]], [[Green Ajah]] {{opsl|23}}, Rebel ambassador to the Dragon in Caemlyn, sent by Rand to help Perrin Aybara in the south, whose adventures she followed there
# [[Verin]], [[Brown Ajah]], secretly [[Black Ajah]] {{opsl|23}}, followed the Dragon and his friends in many circumstances, giving them her help and sacrificing her life for the cause of the Light

==Cairhien sisters==
This is the group of 22 loyalist sisters (5 Reds, 5 Greens, 5 Whites, 3 Browns, 2 Yellows, 2 Greys) that were captured during the battle of [[Dumai's Wells]] and later, when they were captives in [[Cairhien]] Aiel Camp, they were persuaded to swear loyalty to the Dragon by Verin utilizing her mild kind of [[Compulsion]]:
# [[Coiren Saeldain]], [[Gray Ajah]] {{opsl|22}}, head ambassador to the Dragon in Cairhien, she probably fought in Thakan'dar alongside the other sworn sisters
# [[Erian Boroleos]], [[Green Ajah]] {{opsl|23}}, ambassador to the Dragon in Cairhien, among the first to swear loyalty to him, fought during the cleansing of ''saidin'', fought in the [[House Pendaloan]] Estate Battle, she probably fought in Thakan'dar alongside the other sworn sisters
# [[Nesune Bihara]], [[Brown Ajah]] {{opsl|21}}, ambassador to the Dragon in Cairhien, among the first to swear loyalty to him, fought during the cleansing of ''saidin'', fought in the House Pendaloan Estate Battle, she later probably fought in Thakan'dar alongside the other sworn sisters, she survived the [[Last Battle]]
# [[Sarene Nemdahl]], [[White Ajah]] {{opsl|24}}, ambassador to the Dragon in Cairhien, among the first to swear loyalty to him, fought during the cleansing of ''saidin'', fought in House Pendaloan Estate Battle, she fought in Thakan'dar and was captured, Compelled and exhausted by [[Hessalam]]
# [[Beldeine Nyram]], [[Green Ajah]] {{opsl|22}}, among the first to swear loyalty to Rand, fought during the cleansing of ''saidin'', later [[bond]]ed [[Karldin Manfor]] as her [[Warder]], they fought in the House Pendaloan Estate Battle, they fought and were killed during the Last Battle at [[Merrilor]]
# [[Chisaine Nurbaya]], [[Red Ajah]], among the last four to swear loyalty to Rand, she probably fought in Thakan'dar alongside the other sworn sisters
# [[Elza Penfell]], [[Green Ajah]] (and secretly a member of the [[Black Ajah]]) {{opsl|31}}, among the first to swear loyalty to Rand, fought during the cleansing of ''saidin ''and erroneously killed [[Osan'gar]]. She also fought in the House Pendaloan Estate Battle, but revealed herself by freeing [[Semirhage]], then was [[balefire]]d by Rand
# [[Fera Sormen]], [[White Ajah]] (and secretly a member of the Black Ajah) {{opsl|39}}, she probably ran away when the Black Ajah was exposed
# [[Innina Darenhold]], [[Red Ajah]], among the last four to swear loyalty to Rand, she probably fought in Thakan'dar alongside the other sworn sisters
# [[Irgain Fatamed]], [[Green Ajah]], [[stilling|stilled]] by Rand and [[Healed]] by [[Damer Flinn]], she probably fought in Thakan'dar alongside the other sworn sisters
# [[Janine Pavlara]], [[Red Ajah]] {{opsl|33}}, among the last four to swear loyalty to Rand, she probably fought in Thakan'dar alongside the other sworn sisters
# [[Marith Riven]], [[Brown Ajah]] {{opsl|25}}, she probably fought in Thakan'dar alongside the other sworn sisters
# [[Nalaene Forrell]], [[Yellow Ajah]] (and secretly a member of the Black Ajah), she probably ran away when the Black Ajah was exposed
# [[Ronaille Vevanios]], [[White Ajah]] {{opsl|33}}, stilled by Rand and Healed by Damer Flinn, she probably fought in Thakan'dar alongside the other sworn sisters
# [[Sashalle Anderly]] {{opsl|20}}, [[Red Ajah]], stilled by Rand and Healed by Damer Flinn, she took the leadership of the sworn sisters in Cairhien and the stewardship of the kingdom, later she fought in Thakan'dar and was captured, compelled and exhausted by Hessalam
#[[Nelavaire Demasiellin]], [[Green Ajah]] {{opsl|34}}, bonded [[Naeff]], they fought in the House Pendaloan Estate Battle, she probably fought alongside Naeff during the Last Battle
# [[Vayelle Kamsa]], [[Red Ajah]] {{opsl|40}}, among the last four to swear loyalty to Rand, she probably fought in Thakan'dar alongside the other sworn sisters
# [[Turanna Norill]], [[White Ajah]] {{opsl|32}}, she probably fought in Thakan'dar alongside the other sworn sisters
# [[Mayam|Mayam Colona]], [[White Ajah]] {{opsl|27}}, she probably fought in Thakan'dar alongside the other sworn sisters
# [[Cairlyn Nesolle]], [[Yellow Ajah]] {{opsl|28}}, she probably fought in Thakan'dar alongside the other sworn sisters
# [[Elaiva Walfor]], [[Gray Ajah]] {{opsl|25}}, she probably fought in Thakan'dar alongside the other sworn sisters
#[[Razina Hazzan]], [[Brown Ajah]] {{opsl|34}}, she probably fought in Thakan'dar alongside the other sworn sisters

==Asha'man bonded==
This is the group of around 50 sisters that were [[bond]]ed by the [[Asha'man]] led by [[Logain]], so they were indirectly allied to the Dragon. The majority of them were probably later [[turned]] to the shadow. We know the name of 10 of them:

# [[Toveine Gazal]], [[Red Ajah]] {{opsl|25}}, [[bond]]ed by [[Logain Ablar]], fought in the House Pendaloan Estate Battle, was [[turned]] to the [[Shadow]] and so Logain cut their bond
# [[Gabrelle Brawley]], [[Brown Ajah]] {{opsl|25}}, bonded by Logain, fought in the House Pendaloan Estate Battle, captured by [[Mazrim Taim]] and liberated with Logain, later they fought together during the Last Battle
# [[Desandre Alraed]], [[Yellow Ajah]] {{opsl|21}}, probably captured and Turned to the Shadow
# [[Lemai Ambani]], [[Red Ajah]] {{opsl|21}}, bonded by [[Morly Hardlin]], probably captured and Turned to the Shadow
# [[Carniele Emares]], [[Yellow Ajah]] {{opsl|28}}, probably captured and Turned to the Shadow
# [[Akoure Vayet]], [[Gray Ajah]] {{opsl|30}}, probably captured and Turned to the Shadow
# [[Ayako Norsoni]], [[White Ajah]] {{opsl|24}}, bonded by [[Donalo Sandomere]], they fought in the House Pendaloan Estate Battle, they were Turned to the Shadow and during the Last Battle, later they were trapped in a ''[[stedding]]''
# [[Jenare Balmaen]], [[Red Ajah]] {{opsl|31}}, bonded by [[Welyn Kajima]], they fought in the House Pendaloan Estate Battle, they later were captured and Turned to the Shadow
# [[Adrielle]], [[Gray Ajah]], bonded by [[Mezar Kurin]], they fought in the House Pendaloan Estate Battle, they later were captured and Turned to the Shadow
# [[Aisling Noon]], [[Green Ajah]] {{opsl|22}}, bonded by [[Arel Malevin]], they fought in the House Pendaloan Estate Battle, and in the [[Last Battle]]

==Cadsuane's Aes Sedai==
[[Cadsuane]] was leading a group of [[Unaligned Sisters]] when she accepted to be Rand's advisor, so indirectly all of them allied to the Dragon. We know the name of 10 of them:
# Cadsuane Melaidhrin, [[Green Ajah]] {{opsl|15}}, was accepted as Rand's advisor and helped him in many circumstances, fought in [[Thakan'dar]] and became [[Amyrlin Seat]] in the aftermath
# [[Merise Haindehl]], [[Green Ajah]] {{opsl|20}}, bonded [[Jahar Narishma]] as her [[Warder]], they fought during the cleansing of ''saidin'', in the House Pendaloan Estate Battle, and during the Last Battle they initially fought in the [[Borderlands]] and later they helped the Amyrlin Seat in Merrilor
# [[Corele Hovian]], [[Yellow Ajah]] {{opsl|24}}, bonded [[Damer Flinn]] as her Warder, fought during the cleansing of saidin and in the House Pendaloan Estate Battle, Damer was wounded in Thakan'dar by Hessalam
# [[Samitsu Tamagowa]], [[Yellow Ajah]] {{opsl|26}}, was left in Cairhien by Cadsuane to take care of the situation there, after the departure of [[Dobraine Taborwin]] she and Sashalle Anderly took the stewardship of the kingdom
# [[Kumira Dhoran]], [[Brown Ajah]] {{opsl|30}}, was killed by [[Graendal]] during the cleansing of ''saidin''
# [[Daigian Moseneillin]], [[White Ajah]] {{opsl|51}}, bonded [[Eben Hopwil]] as her Warder, fought during the cleansing of ''saidin'', fought in the House Pendaloan Estate Battle, she was later killed by [[Shaidar Haran]]
# [[Niande Moorwyn]], [[Gray Ajah]] {{opsl|33}}, former advisor to King [[Galldrian]] of Cairhien; helped Rand and Cadsuane flee from the rebel camp outside Cairhien when a [[bubble of evil]] erupted
# [[Rosara Medrano]], [[Brown Ajah]] {{opsl|38}}, she stayed in Cairhien along with Samitsu
# [[Silvane Redfor]], [[Green Ajah]] {{opsl|39}}, she stayed in Cairhien along with Samitsu
# [[Shahal Comanli]], [[Gray Ajah]] {{opsl|40}}, she stayed in Cairhien along with Samitsu

==Other female channellers==
#[[Aviendha]], {{opsl|14}}, helped Rand especially in the Aiel Waste and in Cairhien, but afterwards was mostly occupied by becoming a Wise One
#The [[Wise Ones]] helped Rand in many circumstances
# [[Alivia]], {{opsl|7}}, the very powerful former ''[[damane]]'' was brought to the Dragon's entourage by Nynaeve, and proved to be useful in many circumstances
# [[Shalon din Togara Morning Tide]], >{{opsl|23}}, the [[Windfinder]] of her sister [[Harine din Togara Two Winds]], [[Wavemistress]] of [[Clan Shodein]] and [[Sea Folk]] ambassador to the Dragon; along with Rand and many sisters Shalon fought the [[Forsaken]] during the cleansing of ''saidin''
# [[Talaan din Gelyn]], {{opsl|8}}, an apprentice Windfinder who ran away with [[Merilille Ceandevin]] and joined the [[Dragonsworn]] on the slopes of Thakan'dar
